name: Playwright MCP (Microsoft)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C8, C10; partly meets C5, C7, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @playwright/mcp@0.0.85 names the repository `git+https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.0.85 is dated 2026-11-09; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Browser automation is the core function; the README documents file-access restriction by default, origin allow and block lists, and capabilities that must be switched on, and says the origin lists are not a security boundary. Quoted: “By default access to file system is restricted to workspace root directories (or cwd if no roots are configured) only, and navigation to file:// URLs is blocked.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented setup takes no credential; a secrets file option is documented. Quoted: “path to a file containing secrets in the dotenv format”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The documented function is driving a browser to arbitrary pages. The README contains no reference to telemetry. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog. Quoted: “semicolon-separated list of TRUSTED origins to allow the browser to request. Default is to allow all.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README carries a general security statement and a link to MCP security guidance; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content. Quoted: “Playwright MCP is **not** a security boundary.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.25.2 in the repository's package.json. Lower-bound version 1.25.2 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2026-01-07, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
